shortDescription: Germany's financial regulator BaFin said on Thursday  that it had revoked the license of Bank Saderat Iran's Hamburg branch and was ordering its liquidation.

children: Germany's financial regulator BaFin said on Thursday  that it had revoked the license of Bank Saderat Iran's Hamburg branch and was ordering its liquidation.
"As a result, the institution is no longer permitted to conduct banking business," BaFin said.
